items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: And Jack Lane had a band.

ctx.x: There was Fisher and Brown. Fisher and Brown.
That's right. And Jack Lane had a band. Well that was on, he came after, but those fellas they started doing, a little after I did.
That's right. Well now whom did they work and study with down there, the same men that you had?
